scope: Two face-only campaign revision candidates; accepted V9 layout and product/shade evidence unchanged.
recommended: B, subjective visual preference; not owner acceptance

prompts.A:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: TAM Beauty lip oil campaign portrait, candidate A.
Input image 1 is the existing synthetic campaign photograph to EDIT. Create ONE high-resolution portrait with the same 4:5 aspect ratio, framing, pale blush background, white knitted clothing, hand positions, bottle, applicator and product placement. Preserve bottle geometry, tam BEAUTY lettering, clear packaging, coral oil, and applicator accurately. Change only the model's facial rendering, expression, and excessive hair volume, with lighting harmonized on face and neck.
The owner finds the current face too obviously AI-generated. Keep an elegant adult East Asian beauty model in her mid twenties, with polished clear skin and groomed dark hair, but make her look like an individual photographed during a professional beauty shoot. Retain the overall current likeness and attractive fresh impression. Eyes slightly less round and open, anatomically coherent lids and tear ducts, fine separated natural lashes, restrained catchlights rather than huge glossy doll eyes. Preserve subtle natural differences between left and right eyelid and brow height. Give the jaw a gentle realistic transition rather than a pointed V. Lips relaxed, slight naturally uneven tension at the corners, not an exaggerated smile or pout, fine visible lip lines beneath translucent gloss. Gaze engaged with camera, a quiet attentive moment between poses.
Skin: professionally applied sheer satin foundation with fine barely visible skin texture, subtle tonal variation around nose and mouth, no uniform plastic sheen. Realistic soft directional light from upper camera left with gentle fill: restrained cheek highlight, natural shadow beneath nose and chin. Lip oil shine should be the most luminous small detail. Reduce forehead, nose, neck and collarbone slickness. Hair crown slightly flatter, groomed individual strands, restrained volume.
Keep the existing bright clean pink-white campaign palette. Finished photographic detail, sharp natural focus on eyes and mouth, 85mm portrait lens look, believable professional retouching. No freckles, added moles, tired eyes, wrinkles, weathered skin, grain overlay, blur, sepia, dim lighting, beauty-filter symmetry, CGI, porcelain plastic skin, oversized irises, exaggerated eyelash fans. No extra text or watermark. Product and hands unchanged; do not substitute another bottle. Output a single photograph, no collage.
prompts.B:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: TAM Beauty lip oil campaign portrait, candidate B.
Input image 1 is the existing synthetic campaign photo, an edit target for layout, hands and packaging only. Create ONE 4:5 high-resolution photograph. KEEP exactly the existing pale pink background, bright white/pink palette, white knit top, both hands, nails, their placement, coral lip oil bottle with tam BEAUTY logo, transparent cap and applicator orientation. Keep the mouth and product in their present approximate positions so the applicator touches the lower lip naturally. No product redesign.
REPLACE the overly generic doll-like face with a distinct believable adult East Asian beauty model in her mid twenties. The new face must be clearly different in eye shape and facial structure: horizontally elongated almond eyes with gently hooded upper lids, normal-sized brown irises, subtle difference in eyelid folds, soft straight brows with individually groomed hairs; a natural rounded nasal tip, softly defined cheekbones, a slightly broader gently rounded chin and relaxed jaw. An elegant fresh individual with understated confidence, polished beauty campaign styling. Avoid the tiny nose / huge circular eyes / sharply tapered V jaw combination. Natural pretty appearance appropriate to a modern cosmetics campaign.
Expression: softly relaxed mouth without a forced pout or smile, living attentive eyes glancing just beside the camera, very subtle uneven lip corners. She is pausing while applying lip oil. Do not exaggerate asymmetry. Fine normal lips with subtle vertical lines under a translucent glossy finish; not swollen or plastic-looking lips. Lip shine is the focal highlight.
Hair: straight dark hair loosely tucked back with a few fine believable strands, flatter crown and less voluminous waves than input, groomed studio styling. Skin: clear even lightly made-up satin skin, tiny natural pores and gentle color variation, no painted grain or skin damage. Professionally retouched but anatomically credible. No freckles or added spots, no weathered skin, no tired eye bags.
Lighting: large soft studio key upper-left, gentle shadow on opposite cheek and under chin, reflected fill, bright fresh exposure, restrained eye catchlights. Forehead and cheeks mostly satin rather than uniformly wet. Real camera tonal transitions between face, ears and neck. 85mm beauty portrait with eyes, lips and held product crisply focused; no artificial blur or CGI finish.
One photograph only. No collage, watermark, captions or extra typography. Keep packaging and hands unchanged. Do not copy a celebrity or real reference model.
